# Stage aliases must be unique; each repeated pair below fires once.
# ruleid: alias-must-be-unique
FROM ubuntu:22.04 AS base
RUN echo base
FROM alpine:3.18 AS base
RUN echo base-again
# ruleid: alias-must-be-unique
FROM debian:12 AS builder
RUN echo builder
FROM fedora:39 AS builder
RUN echo builder-again
# ok: alias-must-be-unique
FROM ubuntu:22.04
# ok: alias-must-be-unique
RUN echo done
